newsitem.title: USA: Empiric Energy says to sell properties.
newsitem.headline: Empiric Energy says to sell properties.

text.p: Empiric Energy Inc said Monday it has entered into a letter of agreement with a Texas-based energy firm to sell its working interest in its West Texas Panhandle producing properties for $300,000, along with a two-year option to purchase 13,500 leasehold acres for approximately $550,000.
Empiric Energy said the deal should close in approximately 30 days, subject to due diligence by both parties.
The company also said it is currently negotiating a five well "infill" drilling program in Pennsylvania and expects drilling to commence in the next 30 days.
In addition, Empiric also said it is in negotiations with an independent energy company, which would make an approximate $1.5 to $2.0 million investment in Empiric.
Empiric Energy is an oil and gas exploration and production company located in Dallas.
